nodes.summary: Every Hausdorff dimension function $\psi : [0,\infty) \to [0,\infty)$ is continuous.
nodes.title: Continuity of a Hausdorff dimension function

nodes.summary: A Hausdorff dimension function (gauge) is a continuous, non-decreasing function $\psi : [0,\infty) \to [0,\infty)$ with $\psi(0) = 0$ and $\psi(r) > 0$ for every $r > 0$. In particular $\psi(r) \to 0$ as $r \to 0^+$.
nodes.title: Hausdorff dimension function

nodes.summary: If $\psi$ is a Hausdorff dimension function and $r \ge 0$, then $\psi(r) = 0$ if and only if $r = 0$.
nodes.title: A Hausdorff dimension function vanishes only at zero

nodes.summary: If $\psi$ is a Hausdorff dimension function and $r > 0$ is a real number, then $\psi(r) > 0$.
nodes.title: A Hausdorff dimension function is positive at positive radii
A Hausdorff dimension function vanishes at zero

nodes.summary: Every Hausdorff dimension function $\psi : [0,\infty) \to [0,\infty)$ is non-decreasing: if $r \le s$ then $\psi(r) \le \psi(s)$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of a Hausdorff dimension function

nodes.summary: Every Hausdorff dimension function $\psi$ satisfies $\psi(r) \to 0$ as $r \to 0^+$, that is, as $r$ tends to $0$ through positive values.
nodes.title: A Hausdorff dimension function tends to zero at zero

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
